events.t: Exhibited with the Armand Hammer collection from 1969
events.q: Exhibited with the Armand Hammer collection from 1969, starting with Brooks Memorial Art Gallery, Memphis, Tennessee; except all venues between March 26, 1982 (Beijing) and March 9, 1986 (Palm Springs, California).  Work was on long term loan to LACMA.
Edward Le Bas, Brighton (sold Geneva, Christie, Manson & Woods, Nov 6, 1969, no. 155)
Cézanne, Musée Saint Georges, Liège; Musée Granet - Palais de Malte, Aix-en-Provence, 1982.
Rewald, John. _Paul Cezanne: The Watercolors_. Boston: Little, Brown and Company (A New York Graphic Society Book), 1983.
